name: Ca duoi hap
summary: Cá đuối hấp hành is stingray steamed with onion. Diners also eat the fatty liver.
howToEat: Share it at lunch or dinner. The story does not say rice or bún.
where: Đường Duyên Hải and đường Tắc Xuất, xã Cần Giờ.
seoTitle: Ca duoi hap — steamed stingray in Can Gio
seoDescription: Cá đuối hấp hành is stingray steamed with onion, and diners also eat the fatty liver.
